message.content: This image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white serif letters. Above it, text reads "EDISI KHUSUS KEPALA DAERAH PILIHAN 2012". Seven people are posed in front of a small outdoor stall with a corrugated roof. On the left, a woman in a brown patterned batik jacket and black headscarf sits beside a man in a white polo shirt and dark pants seated on a bench. Behind them stands an older man in a white dress shirt. In the center, a man in a navy polo shirt stands holding a glass mug of amber liquid, next to a small chessboard with white pieces. To his right, a man in a yellow polo shirt stands next to a man in a white polo shirt and blue pants sitting on a bench. On the far right, a man wearing a traditional feathered headpiece and dark patterned shirt stands. The group is positioned on a dirt ground scattered with small stones. Large white text at the bottom reads "BUKAN BUPATI BIASA". A barcode and "RP 34.000" are in the bottom left corner. Vertical text on the left margin repeats "EDISI KHUSUS KEPALA DAERAH PILIHAN TEMPO 2012". The background stall features hanging merchandise in colorful plastic packaging.
